title: Ribosomes & Specialized Microbodies
topics: The Svedberg Unit ($S$) Non-Additive Sedimentation Principles
Peptidyl Transferase Ribozymes (23S in Prokaryotes; 28S in Eukaryotes)
Glyoxysomes (Glyoxylate Cycle & Fatty Acid Gluconeogenesis in Seeds)
quickSummary: Ribosomes are non-membranous nucleoprotein translation machines. 70S ribosomes (30S + 50S; 16S, 23S, 5S rRNA) occur in prokaryotes and semi-autonomous organelles; 80S ribosomes (40S + 60S; 18S, 28S, 5.8S, 5S rRNA) occur in eukaryotic cytoplasm. Peptidyl transferase is a ribozyme (23S rRNA in 70S; 28S rRNA in 80S). Single-membrane microbodies include Peroxisomes (catalase H2O2 breakdown & C2 photorespiration), Glyoxysomes (glyoxylate cycle fatty acid conversion in oily seeds), and Sphaerosomes (plant lipid storage).

conceptBreakdown.content:
Ribosomes (Palade particles) are non-membranous ribonucleoprotein complexes.

### Subunit & rRNA Composition
• **Svedberg Unit ($S$)**: Sedimentation coefficient in an ultracentrifuge reflecting mass, density, and 3D hydrodynamic shape ($30S + 50S = 70S$; $40S + 60S = 80S$).
• **Ribozyme Activity**: Peptide bond formation during protein translation is catalyzed directly by the large subunit rRNA acting as a **Ribozyme**:
  - **23S rRNA** in 70S ribosomes.
  - **28S rRNA** in 80S ribosomes.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
MICROBODY CLASSES
                                     │
         ┌───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
         ▼                           ▼                           ▼
    PEROXISOMES                 GLYOXYSOMES                 SPHAEROSOMES
(Flavin Oxidases & Catalase)  (Glyoxylate Cycle Enzymes)   (Plant Lysosome Analog)
 ├── Photorespiration ($C_2$)   ├── Germinating Fatty Seeds ├── Lipid Storage & Cutin
 └── $\beta$-oxidation of fats     (Castor, Sunflower)         │   Synthesis
                                └── Converts Fats ──► Sugar  └── High Acid Phosphatase
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Peroxisomes**:
   - Contain flavin oxidases that generate toxic hydrogen peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) and **Catalase**, which decomposes it: $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{O} + \frac{1}{2}\text{O}_2$.
   - Cooperates in **Photorespiration ($C_2$ Cycle)** in $C_3$ plants (*Chloroplast $\rightarrow$ Peroxisome $\rightarrow$ Mitochondria*).
   - Carries out $\beta$-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids in animal hepatocytes and renal cells.
2. **Glyoxysomes**:
   - Present in germinating oil-rich endospermic seeds (*Castor, Sunflower*).
   - Possess **Glyoxylate Cycle** enzymes (*Isocitrate Lyase, Malate Synthase*) to convert stored fatty acids into soluble glucose (**Gluconeogenesis**) before emergent leaves can photosynthesize.
3. **Sphaerosomes (Oleosomes)**:
   - Single-membrane spherical plant microbodies originating from the ER, dedicated to lipid storage, cutin synthesis, and lysosomal-like hydrolytic activity.
